passages.heading: Usage of dynamic properties
passages.text: Declaring the property (preferred). Adding the #[\AllowDynamicProperties] attribute to the class (which also applies to all child classes). Using a WeakMap if additional data needs to be associated with an object which one does not own.

passages.heading: "${var}" and "${expr}" style interpolation
passages.text: The "${var}" and "${expr}" style of string interpolation is deprecated. Use "$var"/"{$var}" and "{${expr}}", respectively.

passages.heading: MBString
passages.text: Usage of the QPrint, Base64, Uuencode, and HTML-ENTITIES 'text encodings' is deprecated for all MBString functions. Unlike all the other text encodings supported by MBString, these do not encode a sequence of Unicode codepoints, but rather a sequence of raw bytes. It is not clear what the correct return values for most MBString functions should be when one of these non-encodings is specified. Moreover, PHP has separate, built-in implementations of all of them; for example, UUencoded data can be handled using convert_uuencode() / convert_uudecode().

passages.heading: SPL
passages.text: The internal SplFileInfo::_bad_state_ex() method has been deprecated.

passages.heading: Standard
passages.text: utf8_encode() and utf8_decode() have been deprecated.
